source_instruction: The small brown building by the Crusoe Bridge across the River Cam from the Boathouse.

name: Causewayside
source_instruction: A brown building with a gray roof on the edge of the map next to the causewayside building off the fen Causeway

name: Crusoe Bridge
source_instruction: This is a long brown-roofed building along River Cam. The building is surrounded by boats and there is Crusoe Bridge nearby.

name: Graduate Cambridge
source_instruction: A white car parked in the big parking lot located along River Cam, in front of Graduate Cambridge. The white car is parked in one of the four disabled parking spots and there are no cars parked on either side of the car.

name: Grove Lodge
source_instruction: If you're facing the Grove Lodge this is a large building directly to the left of it.

name: Inglis Building
source_instruction: The furthest portion of Inglis Building. It is white and has three air conditioner fans beside five rows of vents between two white roof sections. There is a white van parked beside a set of bronze colored stairs on the farr side of the building.

name: Millworks
source_instruction: Corner section of a brown and white building with a gray roof, that has Bin cut off by the edge of the map, in between the causewayside building and the Millworks building, off the fen Causeway

name: School House
source_instruction: If you're traveling away from the School House on the Fen Causeway this is the very final building to your right at the end of the road.

name: The Fen Causeway
source_instruction: If you're traveling away from the School House on the Fen Causeway this is the very final building to your right at the end of the road.

name: Trumpington Street
source_instruction: This is a large building located near Deer Park and Scholars' Garden. The building is adjacent to Trumpington Street.

name: William Stone Building
source_instruction: A brown house with a gray roof next to the Grove Lodge, with a white truck parked in front of it near the edge of the map, next to the William Stone building

name: Fitzwilliam Pharmacy
source_instruction: The brown and gray building to the left of the Fitzwilliam Pharmacy building.

name: Little St Mary's Lane
source_instruction: This is a building with white walls, three normal floors, and a dome-shaped building on the terrace floor. this building is on the corner of Granta Place road and Little St Mary's Lane road.

name: Pembroke Street
source_instruction: Front section of two story beige building connected to the Pembroke college chapel, off Pembroke Street across from the Kenmare house

name: Queens' College
source_instruction: A long beige building with a gray roof that is next to the old Granary building and across from the Fisher Building off Queens College Road near the edge of the map

name: S & G Cycles
source_instruction: The small brown building next to the S & G Cycles building and a parking lot.

name: Scudamore's Punting Company
source_instruction: This is a large building across the street from Scudamore's Punting Company on Granta Place.

name: Silver Street
source_instruction: A long rectangular beige building with a great roof, next to the old Granary, across from the Fisher Building, off Silver Street

name: St Catharine's College Library
source_instruction: The small building with a white van behind it across the street from the St Catharine's College Library.

name: Study Centre
source_instruction: The building at the far end of the Study Centre building with blue at the bottom and red near the roof and a white chimney.

name: Benson Hall
source_instruction: A section of a multi-colored Brown, Gray Building complex with vegetation on its sidewall, connected with the Hall building and the Magdalene college chapel, next to the Benson hall building and across from the pickerel building off Magdalene Street

name: Bishop Bateman Court (Trinity Hall)
source_instruction: The gray building on New Park Street across from the Bishop Bateman Court (Trinity Hall).

name: Cambridge Union Society
source_instruction: A multi-colored beige and white building that has a another section with a two-tiered brown cone shape for its roof, in between the Cambridge Union society building and the Pearce hostel on the corner of Bridge Street and Round Church Street

name: Castle Street
source_instruction: This is a building located on Magdalene Street next to Magdalene College Chapel. This building is pretty close to Castle Street and Northampton Street.

name: Jesus College Forum
source_instruction: A building with three Gray roof sections that are flat that is located behind the houses on Park Street and beside Jesus College Forum.

name: Jordan's Yard
source_instruction: this is a building complex. There are lower yellow/white/beige colored buildings around this complex. Behind these low buildings are buildings with flat gray/white roofs. There are ventilation units on two of these buildings. this complex is on the corner of church street and bridge street. Jordan's yard footpath separates the complex from the buildings behind it.

name: New Park Street
source_instruction: A brown building with a gray roof and that wraps around the corner of maltings yard and New Park Street, that has the wyng gardens building behind it

name: Old Divinity School
source_instruction: A white and beige building with a gray roof with a large tower on the end of it, that is connected with the hall building off St John's Street across from the old Divinity School

name: Richmond Terrace
source_instruction: The gray, orange and green building on Thompson’s Lane at the intersection with Richmond Terrace.
